title.narrative: Tropical Forest Initiative – support to REDD+ Investment Programme phase II (RIP II) in Ethiopia, 2023-2026

description.narrative: REDD+ Investment Programme phase II (RIP II)’s objective is to contribute to Ethiopia’s Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) on the transformation of the forestry sector and reforestation to meet targets on emission reduction and to promote sustainable social and economic development.

The forest plays a key role in the country’s green growth strategy and is expected to deliver 50 % of the 68 % reduction target in Ethiopia’s Nationally determined contributions (NDC). The objective of RIP II is to contribute to Ethiopia meetings it’s NDC through 1) forest sector transformation, 2) conservation of biodiversity and carbon rich natural forest, 3) restoration of degraded landscapes and 4) strengthening infrastructure for Result-Based-Payments as well as provide alternative livelihood.
